column1: # LOINC codes gated by their CLASS — generated, do not hand-edit.
# <LOINC_NUM>  TAB  <CLASS>
# DERIVATION.  From `loinc_axis.csv` inside the shipped bundle
# (loinc-2.82+2026.08.28-af2524b7a285), selecting CLASS matching:
#     ^(RAD|OB\.US|DENTAL|CELLMARK|NIH\.)
# Regenerate with `python -m scripts.gen_class_gate`.
# WHY A CLASS GATE, ON TOP OF `loinc_skip.txt` AND THE AXIS RULE.
# `engine._axis_gated` rejects a candidate on PROPERTY/SCALE/SYSTEM, which
# catches a code that is the wrong KIND of thing. It cannot catch a code that
# is a perfectly ordinary measurement from a DISCIPLINE a printed lab report
# never contains. Two measured wrong answers were exactly that:
#     癌胚抗原 / carcinoembryonic antigen -> 17188-4  CLASS=CELLMARK
#         *CD66e cells/cells in Blood* — the flow-cytometry cell-surface
#         marker, not the serum tumour marker 2039-6 (CLASS=CHEM). Only the
#         abbreviation `CEA` reached the right one.
#     骨量 -> 34019-0  CLASS=DENTAL
#         a bone volume measured in a tooth space.
# `RAD` alone is 7039 codes and is the single largest block of
# reachable rows that cannot appear as a row on a lab report.
# WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT GATED, and it is the same lesson as `^Patient`:
# consumer and wearable metrics live in classes that look "not lab".
#   H&P.HX    sleep duration 93832-4, deep sleep 93831-6
#   EKG.MEAS  heart-rate variability 76643-6
#   CLIN      step count 41950-7, HRV SDNN 112429-6
#   BDYWGT.*  body bone mass 101685-6, percentage of body fat 41982-0
# A first attempt gated H&P.* and EKG.* and lost all five.
# MEASURED: 217 terms from `test_engine_coverage.py`'s CASES and
# QUALITATIVE_READINGS, zero collateral damage. Blocks 10045 of
# The right long-term home for this is `loinc_skip.txt` INSIDE the bundle,
# regenerated by `scripts/vocabulary_build.py` at the next bundle build; it
# lives here because that rebuild needs the LOINC source release.
